title: rclpy wait_for_message returns (False, None) or hangs: the rospy.wait_for_message equivalent in ROS 2, QoS, timeouts and spinning nodes, measured
excerpt: The rospy.wait_for_message equivalent is in rclpy and rclcpp. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: why it hangs without time_to_wait, returns False on latched and best-effort topics, and killed a MultiThreadedExecutor thread on Humble, plus the QoS and helper-node fixes.
